contract_name: THREE SEPARATE GATES: MISSION SHELL vs SMART ENTRY vs ACADEMIC CONSUMER READINESS

principles.principle_1: MISSION SHELL ACCESS (canEnterMissionShell / canQuickStart) allows selecting a canonical mission and entering the Dashboard shell regardless of academic engine preparation.
principles.principle_2: SMART START (canSmartStart) is strictly fail-closed and reserved for diagnostic / Smart Entry readiness only when proven.
principles.principle_3: ACADEMIC CONSUMERS (Syllabus, DigiBook, Crucible) display truthful governed content or 'Preparing' / 'Not Ready' states without blocking navigation or fabricating readiness.

canEnterMissionShell.definition: Whether the mission shell is selectable by the student.
conditions: status not in [ARCHIVED, HOLD, BLOCKED, DRAFT, PAUSED]

canQuickStart.definition: Action button to persist canonical mission and navigate to Dashboard shell.
canQuickStart.non_blocking_initialization: KnowledgeEngine.initialize runs asynchronously in background without blocking route transition

canSmartStart.definition: Action button to enter diagnostic / Smart Entry flow.
conditions: status in [AVAILABLE, LIVE, PUBLISHED, ACTIVE, CATALOG_VISIBLE, MISSION_COMPLETE, MISSION_AVAILABLE_WITH_PARTIAL_COVERAGE]
